narrative.overview: The site is an exhibition in numbered rooms. Every page is a wall you face; every project hangs as a work in its mat frame with a paper plaque beside it and a working drawing of its stack. Two grounds (plaster, after hours), painted gallery-green walls, and one signal: amber means live now. Everything is square, nothing is glass, and depth exists only as the shadow of the work you are facing.
keyCharacteristics: Committed color: painted walls cover full sections; plaster and plaques carry reading.
One wide grotesk (Archivo) with a width axis: Expanded for wall titles, normal for text. Mono only for catalog data.
Square corners everywhere; no gradients, glass, glow or emoji.
Asymmetric 12-column hangs; rooms separated by deliberate empty wall.
Springs, not easing curves; motion only on the works and the route.

rules.name: The Live Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber means "live now" and nothing else. If an element is not current, new, in progress, or the one primary action, it is ink.

rules.name: The Surface Rule
rules.body: Text on a foreground fill uses text-surface (the ground you are standing on), never a hard-coded background color.

rules.name: The Catalog Rule
rules.body: Mono is for data printed on a label: dates, stacks, catalog numbers. Never for headings, buttons or decoration.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No kicker above a heading. Room numbers sit beside the title as a light numeral.

rules.name: The Facing Rule
rules.body: Only the work in front of you casts a shadow. Containers never carry shadow and border together.

dos: Do paint whole sections gallery green and hang plaques on them; let .wall and .plaque handle contrast.
Do use amber only for live state and the single primary action of a wall.
Do set dates, stacks and counts in .text-catalog.
Do hang works asymmetrically (8 / 5 / 5 offset) and leave empty wall between rooms.
Do use springs from src/lib/motion.ts (--spring-hang, --spring-snap) and keep content visible without JS and under reduced motion.
Do design every surface at 360px first.
donts: Don't use gradients, glassmorphism, backdrop blur, glows or neon.
Don't round corners or build grids of identical rounded cards.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't use emoji or Unicode glyphs as icons; use lucide or the ds brand SVGs.
Don't set small text in #D97706 on plaster.
Don't fade-up every section; only works and the route move.
